description: Refactor literature acquisition to use a registry-backed strategy and adapter architecture while preserving the existing gateway API surface and provider behavior.

userStories.title: Freeze current acquisition gateway compatibility with regression tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want regression tests around the current gateway, unified workflow, and acquisition node behavior so that the adapter refactor preserves the existing external contract.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/test_api_gateway_download.py asserts the current call_api_gateway(...) result contract for at least one existing provider path
tests/test_literature_unified_workflow.py asserts the unified workflow still receives the same gateway-level output semantics through the existing facade
tests/test_agents_acquisition.py asserts the acquisition node stays orchestration-only and does not require provider-specific branching knowledge
uv run pytest -q tests/test_api_gateway_download.py tests/test_literature_unified_workflow.py tests/test_agents_acquisition.py passes
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Validated on 2026-04-05 via uv run pytest -q tests/test_api_gateway_download.py tests/test_literature_unified_workflow.py tests/test_agents_acquisition.py.

userStories.title: Add provider adapter base contract and registry
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a small adapter interface and registry in the gateway layer so that provider dispatch is centralized without changing higher-level callers.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/domain/literature/gateway/base.py with a minimal provider adapter contract
Create src/domain/literature/gateway/registry.py with registration, lookup, unsupported-provider handling, and duplicate-registration behavior
src/domain/literature/gateway/__init__.py exports the new gateway primitives
tests/domain/literature/gateway/test_registry.py covers register, lookup, unknown provider, and duplicate registration behavior
uv run pytest -q tests/domain/literature/gateway/test_registry.py passes
uv run python -m py_compile src/domain/literature/gateway/base.py src/domain/literature/gateway/registry.py src/domain/literature/gateway/__init__.py passes
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Validated on 2026-04-05 via registry export/code checks and uv run pytest -q tests/domain/literature/gateway/test_registry.py.

userStories.title: Route the PMC provider path through the adapter registry
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one existing provider path migrated end-to-end through the adapter layer so that the new architecture proves it can preserve current gateway behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/domain/literature/gateway/adapters/__init__.py and src/domain/literature/gateway/adapters/pmc_adapter.py
tests/domain/literature/gateway/test_pmc_adapter.py verifies the adapter delegates to the existing PMC implementation and returns the current gateway-compatible output
src/domain/literature/gateway/api_gateway.py routes the PMC branch through the registry while keeping call_api_gateway(...) externally compatible
uv run pytest -q tests/domain/literature/gateway/test_pmc_adapter.py tests/test_api_gateway_download.py tests/test_literature_unified_workflow.py passes
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Validated on 2026-04-05 via uv run pytest -q tests/domain/literature/gateway/test_pmc_adapter.py tests/test_api_gateway_download.py tests/test_literature_unified_workflow.py.

userStories.title: Migrate remaining existing provider branches into adapters
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the remaining supported provider branches moved behind thin adapters one by one so that gateway dispatch becomes registry-driven without rewriting provider logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Create thin adapter files only for already-supported providers such as JStage, Unpaywall, Crossref, and other existing branches that are currently implemented
Each migrated provider keeps its current public gateway behavior through compatibility assertions in tests/test_api_gateway_download.py or existing provider-specific tests
src/domain/literature/gateway/api_gateway.py replaces hardcoded provider branching with incremental registry lookup for the migrated providers
Relevant focused provider regression tests pass after each provider migration
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Validated on 2026-04-05 via focused adapter/provider regressions for Crossref, DOAJ, JStage, and Unpaywall plus gateway regression coverage.

userStories.title: Clean up acquisition orchestration boundaries
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want acquisition orchestration to stay in the node and planning layers while provider dispatch lives in the gateway so that responsibilities remain clear after the adapter migration.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/test_agents_acquisition.py asserts the acquisition node orchestrates planning and execution without encoding provider-specific dispatch details
src/agents/acquisition/node.py and thin wrappers only call the preserved facade or planning layer and do not own provider branching
src/domain/literature/acquisition_agent.py keeps planning and normalization responsibilities while execution remains in the gateway layer
uv run pytest -q tests/test_agents_acquisition.py tests/test_literature_unified_workflow.py passes
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Validated on 2026-04-05 via acquisition-node orchestration regressions in tests/test_agents_acquisition.py and unified workflow coverage.
